Hi Sofia — looping in Camila (Security Engineer) and Aditya (Solutions Architect) to answer the technical bits below. I've attached our security brief and KMS overview as an FYI.

Camila / Aditya — key items from FinBank: BYOK integration with customer's KMS (preferably AWS KMS), support for HSM-backed keys, envelope encryption model and whether Redwood has access to plaintext in transit, and SOC 2 artifact access timeline.

Sofia — quick answers in-line from Camila/Aditya below (copied from our internal notes):

> 1) BYOK / BYOK integration?
- Camila: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via an integration point where customers provide an external KMS ARN (AWS) or URL (GCP). We do not persist plaintext key material in our control plane. We encrypt model cache and persisted artifacts with a data encryption key that's wrapped by the customer's CMK.

> 2) HSM-backed keys?
- Aditya: Yes — we support HSM-backed keys (AWS CloudHSM + KMS custom key store). Customers can require FIPS 140-2 level 3 assurance by using a dedicated CloudHSM cluster and locking keys there.

> 3) Envelope + in-transit handling?
- Camila: All network traffic is TLS 1.2+; we terminate TLS at our edge. For customers using CMK, we use envelope encryption so that only the model runtime instances (in the customer's VPC for Private deployments or in dedicated pools for Dedicated) can decrypt the data encryption keys. For hosted workloads, we offer customer key wrapping so the wrapped DEK is stored and only unwrapped in-memory on dedicated hosts; Redwood engineers do not have access to raw keys.

> SOC 2 artifacts / timeline
- Camila: We can provide SOC 2 Type II report redacted under NDA. Typical turnaround from NDA to access is 48–72 hours once legal & security approve. We can also provide a SOC 2 compliance matrix and an executive summary upfront.

Action items:
- Sofia: share the Microsoft questionnaire once procurement gives the go-ahead.
- Marissa / Camila: we'll review and fill the questionnaire; expect first pass in ~5 business days after we receive it.

Let me know if you'd like a short tech call tomorrow with Camila to walk through the encryption flow.

Best,
Marissa (on behalf of Camila & Aditya)
